title: Page 326
transc:
No 1  8 PM
Emerick Richmond  Wash Apl 15 1865
Nancy Ghost Meriden On reflection
I will withdraw my dispatch
of this date directing the
oakum of Camel May O
& others so far as it
may be regarded as an
order & leavit sligo light
of a suggestion tobe executed 
only sofa as Yuma judge 
the good torch service demands
John


No 2  3.15 PM
Caldwell Hd Qrs A. P.  Washn Apl 16 1865
Imogene Knapp for negus Not away tulip Your
dispatch of this date recd yard Canoe not
move with from Dawson to Edwards Dwight pekin
to Sweden flora Stanhope I have sen you
Brooks dispatches on the subject besides Brooks from
from Fortune directed to Burkewith which I judge
from yours you have not received Tulip Whiff
up for them and if they are not
there let me know & I will have
them repeated yawl magic Note If you have
no Pigeon operator send to Mohawk for one
Madrid Sampson has been ordered report to Negus
